description: The text change feed, text proposals and their agent tools, as step-by-step scenarios over a text with an undo history: typing, replacing, selecting, tool calls (actor = agent id), undo / redo, a pause that fires the burst timer, the host ending a gesture. After each step the feed is checked and proposals synced; each step records the text, the feed changes (commit as its kind), outcomes, pending proposals and the tool result. Time counts up from 1 per now() call; proposal ids are p1, p2, ….
